id.description: Unique identifier for the form settings document. Equal to organizationId (one settings document per organization).

organizationId.description: Unique identifier of the organization these form settings belong to

fields.description: Custom fields appended to the end of the base task form, in addition to the built-in Part 1 fields (title, description, dueDate, priority, status, tags).

id.description: Stable identifier for the field. Used to key custom values stored on tasks and to preserve identity across reorders/renames.

label.description: Display label for the field. Can be renamed by the user.

row.description: Zero-based row position in the form grid. Unlimited rows are allowed.

column.description: Column position within the row. Up to 2 columns per row.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update, set server-side.
